title: BGN with the regime price of the market shock SWITCHING SIGN: sigma_z x (-1 / +1), 12-month expected spells, half the time in each regime
question: When the premium on the market shock changes sign by regime, how much of the conditional Sharpe does a constant-weight portfolio keep, and does DKKM (which sees the regime as gam_stand) take the rest?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-27). The campaign's gaps are small because every economy gives the linear sort a NONZERO correlation with the priced exposure: with one priced factor and N = 500, any such portfolio mimics the factor and diversifies the rest, so it earns the factor's whole Sharpe ratio however curved the exposure is (the 2026-10-26 reduced-form sign screen: room is all or nothing). Room needs the exposure to be orthogonal to every linear function of the characteristics -- in the cross-section (a hidden sign: vyg25s, room 0.35, gap +0.18) or in time (a premium whose sign the constant-weight portfolio cannot follow). g0235f scales the price by 0.2 and 3.5 across regimes and the gap stayed at hundredths, because a constant portfolio long market exposure earns in both regimes. At -1 / +1 with equal stationary shares the unconditional premium of every constant portfolio is near zero. bgn_gam exports the regime as gam_stand, which the random features and DKKM condition on; the linear ceiling and the classical estimators hold constant weights, so this is a CONDITIONING room, to be labelled as such in the report.

FEASIBILITY (vasicek.py at these overrides, 2026-10-27): the regime enters only as e^{-beta gmult[s]} (no square root or log of gmult); rstar_gam finds exercise thresholds in both regimes across the beta grid (e.g. 0.052 / 0.039 at beta 0.72); prob_calm 0.5.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-10-27): the constant-weight linear ceiling falls to a fraction of bgnbase's while SR_max stays near it; room above 100% of the linear ceiling; DKKM at least 0.10 above the best classical method, 10 of 10 seeds. FALSIFIED as 'DKKM can time a sign-switching premium from the regime column' if DKKM is within 0.02 of the fair linear.

changes: gmult [0.2, 3.5] -> [-1.0, 1.0]; p01 1/12, p10 2/12 -> 1/12, 1/12 (12-month spells, stationary share 1/2 each); jstar_gam_file Jstar_bgsgn.csv
